slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
A translation slides every point the same distance in the same direction, given by a vector. In coordinates, the translation by vector (a, b) is the rule (x, y) maps to (x + a, y + b).

Every segment joining a point to its image is parallel to the vector and equal in length to it. Repeating one translation over and over makes a frieze pattern, a strip that looks the same after a slide.

Use the controls in the panel. Drag the hollow points on the board.

geo.body:

Work it out, then press Show the answer.
